name: Survey tile in Sagittarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.7 degrees south of the ecliptic in Sagittarius, imaged by SPHEREx 19 times in 7 visits over 49 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 20 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 31 hours starting 2025-09-13, at wavelengths from 1.11 to 4.90 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
